outputPath.description: Folder, relative to the workspace root, receiving the package, each earlier package of the project in it removed first

timestampAuthority.description: Timestamp server ZXPSignCmd -tsa signs against, so a CEP package outlives its certificate

__unparsed__.description: Words after -- of the run, appended after the configured arguments

title: Package
description: Packs the Adobe UXP plugin or CEP extension the project's other builds wrote, else its tracked source folder: a .ccx zip for a manifest.json, a .zxp ZXPSignCmd signs with a certificate it creates for the build for a CSXS/manifest.xml
